items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: she was raised over the lake around where Rickard Lexus come from.

ctx.x: Well tell us some more about Steve Lewis in a minute too.

She, I think she was born over the lake, she was raised over the lake around where Rickard Lexus come from. And she came over here to work to different bands. It seemed as if she didn't take so well. But those that hired her was very well pleased with her because she could read all their music. There was plenty of bands that played songs by ear. She couldn't cut that unless they had the music to it. Couldn't get along so well. So I went back to Steve Lewis. When I first met Steve Lewis, I met him in the Hummin'…
